mapper.insert: INSERT INTO chat_history ( message_id, sender_id, recipient_id, content, message_type, created_at ) VALUES ( #{messageId}, #{chatMessage.senderId}, #{chatMessage.recipientId}, #{chatMessage.content}, #{chatMessage.messageType}, #{chatMessage.timestamp} )
mapper.select: SELECT message_id, sender_id, recipient_id, content, message_type, created_at FROM ( SELECT message_id, sender_id, recipient_id, content, message_type, created_at, ROW_NUMBER() OVER (ORDER BY created_at DESC) as rn FROM chat_history WHERE (sender_id = #{userId1} AND recipient_id = #{userId2}) OR (sender_id = #{userId2} AND recipient_id = #{userId1}) ) WHERE rn <= #{limit} ORDER BY created_at ASC

SELECT partner_id FROM ( SELECT CASE WHEN sender_id = #{userId} THEN recipient_id ELSE sender_id END as partner_id, MAX(created_at) as last_message_time, ROW_NUMBER() OVER ( WHEN sender_id = #{userId} THEN recipient_id ELSE sender_id END ORDER BY MAX(created_at) DESC ) as rn FROM chat_history WHERE sender_id = #{userId} OR recipient_id = #{userId} GROUP BY CASE WHEN sender_id = #{userId} THEN recipient_id ELSE sender_id END ) WHERE rn = 1 ORDER BY last_message_time DESC FETCH FIRST #{limit} ROWS ONLY
